## Friendship Network

```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F}
library(readr)

sheet_id <- "1gK3a24a0fmOqgucUjo4cQ0vM7fJoVK0RVtGl2baYZqg"

url <- paste0("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/", sheet_id, "/export?format=csv")

df <- read_csv(url)

edges <- df %>%
  rename(from = `What is your name?`,
         to = `Who in the class do you consider a friend?`) %>%
  separate_rows(to, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  select(from, to) %>%
  filter(from != to) %>%
  distinct(from, to)


G <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE) |> as_tbl_graph()

# Flag reciprocal edges (must be computed before collapsing dyads)
is_reciprocal <- igraph::which_mutual(G)

# Keep only one edge per dyad so mutual pairs aren't drawn twice
plot_edges <- G |>
  activate(edges) |>
  mutate(reciprocal = ifelse(is_reciprocal, "Reciprocal", "Not Reciprocal")) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(pair_id = paste(pmin(from, to), pmax(from, to))) |>
  distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-pair_id)

tbl_graph(nodes = as_tibble(activate(G, nodes)), edges = plot_edges, directed = TRUE) |>
  ggraph() +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(color = reciprocal)) +
  geom_node_point(size = 5, color = '#33679bff') +
  theme_graph() +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("Reciprocal" = "green", "Not Reciprocal" = "red")) +
  labs(edge_color = "Friendship Type")
```


## Review

- What is the difference between a potential network, an activated network, and a mobilized network?
- Why might SES be related to which networks are activated under job loss threat?

<aside class='notes'>
- Even wider network may not have resources
- Different types of work may require different types of networks
- Higher SES have greater time / money / energy to reach out to more distant connections
- Distant connections respond differently based on SES of asker
</aside>

## Discussion Questions

- What's the difference between an ego and a node?
- When is it better to rely on a close-reciprocal friendship for change versus a buddy system, especially when it comes to serious issues. When does the trust/lower pressure of a close friendship outweigh the professionalism/forced accountability of a buddy system and vice versa?

## Discussion Questions

- If people do indeed have access to a much larger social network than the part they typically think about and/or use, what causes certain relationships to become "active", especially when someone is under stress or needs help?
- Looking at your own relationships, is having structural holes in your network an advantage, something positive or negative?

## Discussion Questions

- In an anonymous online community users may be structurally embedded in a dense network without being personally identifiable outside of that setting. Would the same network structure still produce similar behavioral constraints, or does anonymity weaken the relationship between structural constraint and behavioral constraint?

# Ego Network Activity

## What do our ego networks look like?

- From time to time, most people discuss important matters with other people. Looking back over the last 6 months, who are the people with whom you discussed matters important to you?

## Making Connections

- Make an edgelist for each connection, with tie strength of:
	- Total strangers: 0
	- Especially close: 2
	- In between: 1

## Write attributes of your connections to a node attribute file

 - Sex
 - Education (years of education)
 - Race
 - Age
 - Kin or non-kin (are they related to you?)


## Calculate your statistics

- Network size
- Kin network size
- Non-kin network size
- Density
- Age heterogeneity
- Education heterogeneity
- Race heterogeneity
- Sex heterogeneity (proportion in majority)
